description: Neutral governance-integration boundary owned by the Agent Runtime. The runtime asks whether a consequential transition may proceed and obeys the answer. It never authors policy, binds a decision, or creates authority.

method.name: evaluate
method.signature: evaluate(context: ExecutionContext, proposed_transition: str, evaluation_time: float) -> GovernanceEvaluation
method.evaluation_time: caller-controlled (runtime supplies its injected clock value)

mapping.HOLD: WAIT (task/workflow WAITING; no authority created; provider not called)
mapping.ESCALATE: PAUSE (workflow PAUSED pending external authority/review; provider not called)

fail_closed: A missing evaluation or unrecognized disposition resolves to STOP, never CONTINUE. HOLD and ESCALATE are never converted to CLEAR.
